entries.7a180a5c75e39aa7: This business manufactures and sells organic and inorganic chemicals, and chemical products refined and processed from them. In addition to selling general-purpose chemicals used for cleaning, surface treatment and as solvents for dissolving resins and other materials, it also manufactures, sells and provides contract processing of high-purity chemicals used in electronics fields such as semiconductors, electronic devices and batteries. Revenue for the fiscal year ended March 2026 was ¥3,206 million.
entries.7af568359164e3a8: This business intermediately treats and recycles industrial waste discharged from manufacturing plants, including spent waste solvents, waste acids and waste containing valuable metals, using methods such as distillation and solvent extraction, and sells recycled products that are reused for their original purposes or as materials for paints, cleaning agents, surface treatment agents and others. Revenue for the fiscal year ended March 2026 was ¥7,239 million, the largest of the 5 businesses. A&H Japan Co., Ltd., which became a wholly owned subsidiary in October 2025, is responsible for the recycling of precious metals and rare metals.

entries.a444b44f3023c6a9: A company that recycles industrial waste from manufacturers and handles this together with the manufacture and sale of chemicals and oil products as an integrated operation.
entries.b1f4b49f2ae62a33: This is a single-segment business composed of the company and 8 consolidated subsidiaries. With the business concept of 'Creating Environmental Needs', it is characterized by providing integrated services, from the manufacture and sale of chemical and oil-based products to the collection, intermediate treatment and recycling of industrial waste after use, including logistics and quality assurance. Revenue for the fiscal year ended March 2026 was ¥20,263 million.
entries.ca33cd6fc8746688: This business manufactures and sells oil-based products such as lubricants and metalworking fluids, industrial cleaning agents, and various auxiliary materials used in automobile manufacturing processes, mainly for automobile manufacturers and automotive parts manufacturers. It began in Aichi Prefecture as sales of oil-based products and chemicals for automobile-related companies, and is the business that became the foundation of the company. Revenue for the fiscal year ended March 2026 was ¥2,352 million.
entries.fe502aff8f431dc0: This business provides integrated solutions for dismantling and cleaning the equipment and other facilities of manufacturing customers, and for the treatment of the waste generated in connection with this work. It handles the proper treatment of PCB-containing waste and, when modifying or abolishing chemical plants and similar facilities, performs asbestos analysis, dismantling and cleaning, collection and transport, and coordination of waste treatment. Revenue for the fiscal year ended March 2026 was ¥1,559 million.
